arxiv-2102-11614.title: Self-Supervised Noisy Label Learning for Source-Free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2102-11614.creator: Weijie Chen, Luojun Lin, Shicai Yang, Di Xie, Shiliang Pu, Yueting Zhuang, Wenqi Ren, chenweijie5@hikvision.com, linluojun2009@126.com, {yangshicai,xiedi,pushiliang.hri,renwenqi}@hikvision.com, yzhuang@zju.edu.cn
arxiv-2102-11614.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Weijie Chen, Luojun Lin, Shicai Yang, Di Xie, Shiliang Pu, Yueting Zhuang, Wenqi Ren, chenweijie5@hikvision.com, linluojun2009@126.com, {yangshicai,xiedi,pushiliang.hri,renwenqi}@hikvision.com, yzhuang@zju.edu.cn. It is a strong prerequisite to access source data freely in many existing unsupervised domain adaptation approaches. However, source data is agnostic in many practical scenarios due to the constraints of expensive data transmission and data privacy protection. Usually, the given source domain pre-trained model is expected to optimize with only unlabeled target data, which is termed as source-free unsupervised domain adaptation.

arxiv-2103-16470.title: Depth-conditioned Dynamic Message Propagation for Monocular 3D Object Detection
arxiv-2103-16470.creator: Li Wang 1 Liang Du 1 ∗ Xiaoqing Ye 2 ∗ Yanwei Fu 1 Guodong Guo 2 Xiangyang Xue 1 Jianfeng Feng 1 Li Zhang 1 1 Fudan University 2 Baidu Inc
arxiv-2103-16470.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Li Wang 1 Liang Du 1 ∗ Xiaoqing Ye 2 ∗ Yanwei Fu 1 Guodong Guo 2 Xiangyang Xue 1 Jianfeng Feng 1 Li Zhang 1 1 Fudan University 2 Baidu Inc. The objective of this paper is to learn context- and depth-aware feature representation to solve the problem of monocular 3D object detection.

arxiv-2109-01605.title: Representing Shape Collections With Alignment-Aware Linear Models
arxiv-2109-01605.creator: Romain Loiseau romain.loiseau@enpc.fr, Tom Monnier tom.monnier@enpc.fr, Mathieu Aubry mathieu.aubry@enpc.fr, Loïc Landrieu loic.landrieu@ign.fr
arxiv-2109-01605.description: Abstract In this paper, we revisit the classical representation of 3D point clouds as linear shape models. Our key insight is to leverage deep learning to represent a collection of shapes as affine transformations of low-dimensional linear shape models. Each linear model is characterized by a shape prototype, a low-dimensional shape basis and two neural networks.

arxiv-2206-10715.title: A method to computationally screen for tunable properties of crystalline alloys
arxiv-2206-10715.creator: Rachel Woods-Robinson* † 1,2, Matthew K. Horton* 2,3, Kristin A. Persson 3,4
arxiv-2206-10715.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Rachel Woods-Robinson* † 1,2, Matthew K. Horton* 2,3, Kristin A. Persson 3,4. Conventionally, high-throughput computational materials searches start from an input set of bulk compounds extracted from material databases, but in contrast many real functional materials are heavily-engineered mixtures of compounds rather than single bulk compounds. We present a framework and open-source code to automatically construct and analyze possible alloys and solid solutions from a set of existing, experimental or calculated ordered compounds, without requiring additional metadata except crystal structure.

arxiv-2208-02075.title: Entanglement spectrum and entropy in Floquet topological matter
arxiv-2208-02075.creator: Longwen Zhou
arxiv-2208-02075.description: Abstract Entanglement is one of the most fundamental features of quantum systems. In this work, we obtain the entanglement spectrum and entropy of Floquet noninteracting fermionic lattice models and build their connections with Floquet topological phases. Topological winding and Chern numbers are introduced to characterize the entanglement spectrum and eigenmodes.

arxiv-2209-03662.title: On holomorphic mappings with relatively p p -compact range
arxiv-2209-03662.creator: A. Jiménez-Vargas
arxiv-2209-03662.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. Jiménez-Vargas. Related to the concept of p p -compact operator with p ∈ [ 1 , ∞ ] p\in[1,\infty] introduced by Sinha and Karn [ 20 ] , this paper deals with the space ℋ 𝒦 p ∞ ​ ( U , F ) \mathcal{H}^{\infty}_{\mathcal{K}_{p}}(U,F) of all Banach-valued holomorphic mappings on an open subset U U of a complex Banach space E E whose ranges are relatively p p -compact subsets of F F .

arxiv-2209-14091.title: Offensive language detection on Twitter
arxiv-2209-14091.creator: Nikhil Chilwant, Syed Taqi Abbas Rizvi, Hassan Soliman
arxiv-2209-14091.description: Abstract Detection of offensive language in social media is one of the key challenge for social media . Researchers have proposed many advanced methods to accomplish this task. In this report, we try to use the learnings from their approach and incorporate our ideas to improve upon it. We have successfully achieved accuracy of 74% in classifying offensive tweets.

arxiv-2210-15036.title: Edge channels in graphene Fabry-Pérot interferometer
arxiv-2210-15036.creator: S. Ihnatsenka
arxiv-2210-15036.description: Abstract Quantum-mechanical calculations of electron magnetotransport in graphene Fabry-Pérot interferometers are presented with a focus on the role of spatial structure of edge channels. For an interferometer that is made by removing carbon atoms, which is typically realized in nanolithography experiments, the constrictions are shown to cause strong inter-channel scattering that establishes local equilibrium and makes the electron transport non-adiabatic.

arxiv-2302-09275.title: Structural Neural Additive Models: Enhanced Interpretable Machine Learning
arxiv-2302-09275.creator: Mattias Luber, Anton Thielmann, Benjamin Säfken
arxiv-2302-09275.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) have shown exceptional performances in a wide range of tasks and have become the go-to method for problems requiring high-level predictive power. There has been extensive research on how DNNs arrive at their decisions, however, the inherently uninterpretable networks remain up to this day mostly unobservable "black boxes".

arxiv-2305-17763.title: NeurOCS: Neural NOCS Supervision for Monocular 3D Object Localization
arxiv-2305-17763.creator: Zhixiang Min, Bingbing Zhuang, Samuel Schulter, Buyu Liu, Enrique Dunn, Manmohan Chandraker
arxiv-2305-17763.description: Abstract Monocular 3D object localization in driving scenes is a crucial task, but challenging due to its ill-posed nature. Estimating 3D coordinates for each pixel on the object surface holds great potential as it provides dense 2D-3D geometric constraints for the underlying PnP problem.

arxiv-2309-05210.title: Understanding the Impact of Post-Training Quantization on Large Language Models
arxiv-2309-05210.creator: Somnath Roy
arxiv-2309-05210.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly increasing in size, with the number of parameters becoming a key factor in the success of many commercial models, such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Bard. Even the recently released publicly accessible models for commercial usage, such as Falcon and Llama2, come equipped with billions of parameters.

arxiv-2410-10385.description: Abstract Quantum antiferromagnets based on the square-kagome lattice are proving to be a fertile platform for realizing nontrivial phenomena in frustrated magnetism. Recently, several decorated square-kagome compounds of the nabokoite family have been synthesized, allowing for experimental exploration of model Hamiltonians.

plos-pone-0012061.description: PLOS ONE research article. Invasive species can dramatically impact natural populations, especially those living on islands. Though numerous examples illustrate the ecological impact of invasive predators, no study has examined the genetic consequences for native populations subject to invasion. Here we ca

pmc-11267970.title: A framework for ex-ante evaluation of the potential effects of risk equalization and risk sharing in health insurance markets with regulated competition
pmc-11267970.creator: Richard C van Kleef, Mieke Reuser, Pieter JA Stam, Wynand PMM van de Ven
pmc-11267970.description: Many health insurance markets are organized by principles of regulated competition. Regulators of these markets typically apply risk equalization (aka risk adjustment) and risk sharing to mitigate risk selection. Risk equalization and risk sharing can have various positive and negative effects on efficiency and fairness. This paper provides a comprehensive framework for ex-ante evaluation of these effects.

pmc-11610442.title: Genetic diagnosis of the Ehlers-Danlos syndromes
pmc-11610442.creator: Johannes Zschocke, Serwet Demirdas, Fleur S. van Dijk
pmc-11610442.description: The Ehlers-Danlos syndromes (EDS) represent a group of genetically diverse disorders characterized by the variable combination of joint hypermobility, hyperextensibility of the skin, and connective tissue fragility affecting the skin and other organs. Based on clinical features, 13 different types of EDS have been delineated, 12 of which represent monogenic conditions caused by pathogenic variants in 21 confirmed genes.

pmc-12525949.title: Rhizosphere Engineering in Saline Soils: Role of PGPR and Organic Manures in Root–Soil Biochemical Interactions for Allium Crops
pmc-12525949.creator: Tarek Alshaal, Nevien Elhawat, Szilvia Veres
pmc-12525949.description: Soil salinity disrupts rhizosphere interactions, impairing root–microbe symbioses, nutrient uptake, and water relations in onion (Allium cepa L.) and garlic (Allium sativum L.). This study evaluated the efficacy of biofertilizers (Azotobacter chroococcum SARS 10 and Azospirillum lipoferum SP2) and organic amendments (sewage sludge and poultry manure) in salt-affected soils in Kafr El-Sheikh, Egypt.

pmc-12959300.title: Medication Adherence and Antithrombotic Therapy Outcomes
pmc-12959300.creator: Naoki Chiba, Takashi Noda, Kotaro Nochioka, Koichi Kaikita, Masaharu Akao, Junya Ako, Tetsuya Matoba, Masato Nakamura, Katsumi Miyauchi, Nobuhisa Hagiwara, Kazuo Kimura, Kunihiko Matsui, Hisao Ogawa, Satoshi Yasuda, AFIRE Investigators
pmc-12959300.description: BackgroundThe AFIRE (Atrial Fibrillation and Ischemic Events With Rivaroxaban in Patients With Stable Coronary Artery Disease) trial demonstrated that rivaroxaban monotherapy has noninferior efficacy and superior safety compared with combination therapy (rivaroxaban plus a single antiplatelet) in patients with atrial fibrillation and stable coronary artery disease.

pmc-13179949.title: Bridging monitoring gaps in global drylands with big data and collaboration
pmc-13179949.creator: Tom Bruce, Rajan Amin, Kausik Banerjee, José Carlos Brito, Bogdan Cristescu, Mohammad S. Farhadinia, Matthew Scott Luskin, Brett Lyons, David Olson, Joaquín Vicente, Robert A. Montgomery
pmc-13179949.description: Large-scale monitoring networks employing remote sensors have harnessed big data to evaluate conservation efforts on a global scale. While dryland ecosystems are anticipated to expand, and management activities like rewilding and habitat restoration are increasing, the use of data streams and modern analytical methods to plan conservation interventions and quantify their effectiveness remains limited.

pmc-13583733.title: CD36 is associated with myocardial ischemia-reperfusion-induced renal injury in diabetic rats, accompanied by alterations in the PI3K/Akt/eNOS pathway
pmc-13583733.creator: Kai Wang, Huimin Liu, Rong Chen, Qingtao Meng
pmc-13583733.description: BackgroundCD36, a lipid transporter, is markedly upregulated in the diabetic kidney. However, whether CD36 contributes to renal injury following myocardial ischemia–reperfusion (I/R) in diabetes remains unknown. This study aimed to identify the role of CD36 in myocardial I/R-induced renal injury in diabetic rats and to investigate the mechanisms involved.
